3. No corresponding meter reading order and no meter reading result exists for the uploaded meter reading result.

In this case, the key fields for one of the following alternatives must be maintained:

o Serial Number, Register, Meter Reading Date

If the serial number is not unique in the system, a material must also be entered.
o Serial Number, Register, Meter Reading Date
If the serial number is not unique in the system, a material number must also be entered.

o Point of Delivery, Register, Meter Reading Date

You can also change the meter reading results using BOR method UPLOAD or BOR object MTRREADDOC. the interface of the
method contains the following parameters:

e MeterReadResChange (for changing meter reading results)

e MeterReadResUpdate (for updating meter reading results)

Activities
Change Meter Reading Results Using IDoc Category ISU_MR_UPLOADO2

1. Change the meter reading results using IDoc category ISU_LMR_UPLOADOZ2 and fill in segment EIBPEABLUCHANGE with
the upload data for the meter reading results to be changed.

2. Import the IDoc into the system and check the log for the upload process (IUPP).

Update Meter Reading Results Using IDoc Category ISU_MR_UPLOADO2

1. Update the meter reading results using IDoc category ISU_MR_UPLOADO2 and fill in segment ELBPEABLUUPDATE with the
upload data for the meter reading results to be updated.

2. Import the IDoc into the system and check the log for the upload process (IUPP).

Change Meter Reading Results Using BOR Method ‘Upload’ of BOR object ‘MTRREADDOC’

1. Fill the MeterReadResChange parameter with uploaded data for the meter reading results to be changed.

2. Execute the method.
Update Meter Reading Results Using BOR Method ‘Upload’ of BOR object ‘MTRREADDOC’

1. Fill the MeterReadResUpdate parameter with uploaded data for the meter reading results to be updated.

2. Execute the method.

Correction of Plausible Meter Reading Results
